title_sq: DUPLEX ME OBORR & PISHINE PRIVATE TEK KODRA E DIELLIT
description_sq:

title_en: DUPLEX WITH COURTYARD & PRIVATE SWIMMING POOL NEAR SUN HILL
description_en: An exclusive duplex apartment is offered for sale, located in one of the most sought-after and elite residences in Tirana. The property combines spacious interior spaces with a private courtyard and swimming pool, creating a comfortable and premium lifestyle for the family. 📐 Main property data • Typology: Duplex Apartment • Physical area Floor 1: 98.4 m² • Physical area Floor 2: 97 m² • Total internal area: 195.4 m² • Private yard area: 119 m² • Private pool: about 24 m² 🏡 Layout of Apartment Floor 1 • Spacious living room • Dining area • Modern open kitchen • 1 Toilet • Direct access to the courtyard and private pool Floor 2 • 2 Bedrooms • 2 Toilets • Distribution corridor • Staircase connecting to the lower floor ✨ Features & Advantages • Large private courtyard for relaxation and family activities • Private pool • Duplex layout with functional spaces • Natural lighting in all areas • Elite and safe residence • Highly sought after residential and investment area This property represents an ideal combination of comfort, privacy and modern living, offering a unique environment for those looking for a high quality of life in one of the most prestigious areas of Tirana. 📞 For more information or to arrange a visit to the property, contact us.
